negative_controls.description: Replaying the trace-derived workflow on mutated inputs produces a different outcome digest than the recorded log.
Dropping the last generated stage makes replay diverge, so stages are load-bearing rather than decorative.
A candidate whose description mentions the cited gap but has no typed covers: output does not close the gap.
A workflow that typed-covers a different category leaves the cited gap in place on re-measure.
negative_controls.good_state_output: cited gap absent after generated candidate

negative_controls.description: Deleting one leaf line from the spec drops the parsed total by one; the finder does not hardcode 96.

notes: G-1 delivery of IMP-0194 workflow generation. Two independent signals measured live: trace replay outcome equality, and cited-gap absence on a fresh gap-finder run. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. cloud ok is not consulted.
question: Synthesize a workflow from (a) a recorded successful ad-hoc execution trace, or (b) a coverage gap computed by the gap finder. A trace-derived workflow must replay the trace's outcome on the same inputs, and a gap-derived workflow must close the specific gap it cites — verified by re-running the gap finder afterwards and showing that gap absent.

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0144 (replay-log format as a product surface) and IMP-0178 (coverage-gap finder as a product surface) are not delivered in this worktree. This unit ships a self-contained replay log + gap finder sufficient to compile and re-measure generated workflows.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: After IMP-0144/IMP-0178 land, compile one live recorded run and one live gap-finder row through from_trace / from_gap and re-run the two named probes.

reviewer.method: re-measure find_gaps before/after generated candidate, plus prose-only and wrong-category twins, plus spec-leaf deletion.
reviewer.obligation: The cited gap must be absent on a fresh gap-finder run after adding the generated workflow, and must remain present for prose-only and wrong-category twins.

title: Workflow generation from an execution trace or a measured benchmark gap
